metadata.policy_note: intended_asin and observed_redirect_target are intentionally stored in separate fields and never merged. Any value not confirmed from an official source is left blank and flagged as unverified.

irregularities.title: Intended ASINs not explicitly confirmed by submitter
irregularities.description: Submitted URLs use 9-character link.amazon short codes (B0hmGG4m2, B03QDuGdo, B0hpD2JGQ), whereas official Amazon ASINs are 10-character identifiers. Intended ASIN is left blank and never merged with observed_redirect_target.
irregularities.recommended_action: Confirm intended 10-character ASIN for each submitted link before scaling.

irregularities.title: Duplicate product URL in submitted input
irregularities.description: https://link.amazon/B03QDuGdo appears twice consecutively in the submitted product list. Consolidated into 1 canonical catalog entry (B0BSKQW2T2) while retaining both lines in the audit register.
irregularities.recommended_action: Confirm whether Line 3 was an accidental paste or a placeholder for another product.

irregularities.title: Intermittent HTTP 500 error observed on link.amazon/B0hmGG4m2
irregularities.description: Initial fetch of https://link.amazon/B0hmGG4m2 on 2026-11-20 returned HTTP 500; a subsequent fetch resolved to https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08FKW9JRM.
irregularities.recommended_action: Replace ambiguous short link with a validated Special Link after Associates Central testing.

irregularities.title: Unresolved tracking and compliance status on supplied link.amazon URLs
irregularities.description: Observed redirects did not display a visible tag= parameter (such as tag=shopnow047c-20), carrying btn_type=ss and btn_ref=srctok-... instead. Per project rules, supplied short links are NOT claimed to be invalid; their exact compliance status is unresolved until tested in the enrolled Associates workflow and verified in Associates reports.
irregularities.recommended_action: Test one Special Link per product in Associates Central / SiteStripe and confirm destination and tracking report before scaling.

irregularities.title: Creators API required before displaying live prices or customer star ratings
irregularities.description: Amazon Associates Participation Requirements §2(b) and §6(t) prohibit static display of live prices, availability, and customer star ratings/reviews unless served via Amazon links or Creators API / PA-API (with PA-API 5 now deprecated in favor of Creators API).
irregularities.official_source_label: Amazon Associates Program Policies & Creators API Notice
irregularities.recommended_action: Integrate Creators API with <=24h cache TTL and required price/availability timestamp disclaimers; keep buyer CTAs directing users to Amazon for current pricing.

irregularities.title: Unconfirmed fee-tier mapping within Home & Kitchen breadcrumb
irregularities.description: Both kitchen storage items sit under Home & Kitchen > Kitchen & Dining > Storage & Organization. Amazon's Standard Commission Income Statement lists Kitchen at 4.50% and Home / Home Improvement at 3.00%. Effective assigned fee tier is left blank until verified in first-party Associates earnings reports.
irregularities.official_source_label: Amazon Associates Standard Commission Income Statement
irregularities.recommended_action: Confirm actual credited category rate on first qualifying order report.

irregularities.title: ORDORA B08DY9HRWD listing discrepancies and Prime-exclusive pricing
irregularities.description: Listing shows Prime-exclusive price ($17.74 vs $23.99 regular), states 'Up to 11"' in the title vs 'up to 12 inches' in product bullets, and displays a newer heavy-duty model notice (B0BYYTQMTR).
irregularities.recommended_action: Note Prime-only pricing caveat and cookware diameter variance in buyer guide; verify whether B08DY9HRWD or B0BYYTQMTR is preferred.

irregularities.title: Self-hosted analytics endpoint and Google Search Console verification pending deployment
irregularities.description: GitHub Pages hosts static files only. The 5-event privacy-preserving client tracker records local diagnostics until a self-hosted endpoint URL (analytics-server/server.mjs) is deployed and configured. Search Console ownership verification requires domain owner action.
irregularities.official_source_label: Google Search Central — Qualify Outbound Links
irregularities.recommended_action: Deploy analytics-server/server.mjs, set endpoint URL in assets/js/analytics.js config, and submit sitemap.xml in Google Search Console.
